project_name: Jeemains.ai - Ultimate 5-Color Segmented Analytics & Exam Portal

brand.theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST + ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO

palette_5_color_segmentation.description: 5 distinct, high-contrast, APCA-compliant color segments used across Results, Navigation, and Meters

color_1_maroon.label: Brand Anchor / Total Score / Core Identity
color_1_maroon.usage: Hero tiles, primary badges, main header accents, overall score ring

color_2_emerald.label: Accuracy / Correct / High Confidence Meter
color_2_emerald.usage: Correct outcomes, last 5 mock accuracy meter, high mastery tags, positive trend indicators

color_3_sapphire.label: Real World Expected Rank / Peer Benchmarks
color_3_sapphire.usage: Expected rank meter gauge, peer cohort rank, percentile badges, comparison overlays

color_4_amber.label: Improvement Growth / Review / Skipped Questions
color_4_amber.usage: Improvement trend curves, skipped items, pending reviews, moderate confidence warnings

color_5_crimson.label: Report Priorities / Incorrect / Flagged Issues
color_5_crimson.usage: Top reported content issue alerts, incorrect outcomes, penalty marks, urgent fix items

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

mono_numeric.usage: Scores, ranks, percentages, timers, timestamps, receipts, formula outputs, data tables

home_page.structure: Hero eyebrow + big 5-color high-impact exam bento grid + quick action strip + recent mock drawer

exam_boxes.style: Large direct-access bento cards with vibrant individual accent themes (JEE Main = Maroon/Sapphire, BITSAT = Emerald/Amber, COMEDK = Crimson/Purple)
exam_boxes.grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 lg:gap-8
exam_boxes.features: 1-click direct buttons to Mocks, Chapter Practice, and Results History with badge counter

results_page.segmentation: 5-color status bar at top + dual view switcher (Analysis / Solutions) + sticky quick-jump drawer
results_page.rank_meter: Gauge & bell curve card comparing Real-World Expected Rank (e.g., #1,250 - #1,800 based on NTA historical scoring) vs App Cohort Rank (#14/2,400 students)
results_page.improvement_meter: Dual-axis Recharts graph showing First Mock vs Latest Mock vs Rolling Trend with +% gain metrics
results_page.confidence_meter: Rolling 5-mock weighted accuracy gauge with confidence threshold slider (default 0.20)
results_page.solutions_navigation: Sticky top bar with select dropdown, prev/next arrows, 5-color filter tabs, and heat-map question matrix

profile_my_tests.structure: Complete 'My Tests' hub in Profile containing Saved Papers, Ongoing Drafts, and Completed Attempts
profile_my_tests.side_by_side: Comparable attempts side-by-side comparison matrix showing score delta, accuracy diff, time taken, and question-by-question response breakdown

report_priorities.structure: Prioritized question report triage drawer & studio panel
report_priorities.grouping: Grouped by Question ID / Published Version with distinct student counts (e.g., '14 students reported Q42 in Ver 2')
report_priorities.sorting: Most reported questions floating to top with distinct Crimson highlight for urgent editorial review

components_and_ui_library.buttons: Shadcn Button heavily styled with rounded-xl, 1px subtle borders, and smooth transform hover effects
components_and_ui_library.cards: Card with 1px solid stroke (border-border/60), subtle ambient shadow, nested radii (child <= parent), p-6 or p-8 internal padding
components_and_ui_library.tabs: Shadcn Tabs with custom 5-color active indicators and full keyboard accessibility
components_and_ui_library.select: Shadcn Select for question jumps and filter selection
components_and_ui_library.toasts: Sonner toasts position top-center with custom maroon/emerald/crimson accents

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 5-color palette (#5C0025, #059669, #2563EB, #D97706, #DC2626) for segmenting Results, Solution navigation, and Meters.
Ensure explicit distinction between Real-World Expected Rank (verified historical cutoff data) vs App Cohort Rank (live student sample).
Calculate Confidence Meter as the rolling weighted accuracy of the last 5 comparable full mocks.
Ensure Improvement Meter renders a clear Recharts graph comparing first attempt vs latest attempt with delta indicators.
Build the complete 'My Tests' section in Profile with Saved Papers, Ongoing Drafts, and side-by-side comparison for same-paper attempts.
Ensure Question Reports in Studio sort repeatedly reported questions to the top by distinct student count.
Make Home page exam cards large, colorful, direct-access bento boxes with high visual punch.
Every key interactive element MUST retain or include data-testid attributes for testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_requirement: All buttons, links, selects, tabs, inputs, and meter cards MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted transitions for color, border, and background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA / WCAG AA standards. Always set hover text color explicitly when background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_and_collision: All cards with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.font_rules: Use Figtree for main headings and UI text, and Roboto Mono for scores, metrics, ranks, and percentages.
